text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Right now, today, right here is the turning point—)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Dig in, run—seize it!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Daaaah!!
Hanshin Racecourse was engulfed in tremendous cheers.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan...!
Incredible, incredible, incredible! Did you see that? That run of hers!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! She kept speeding up faster and faster!
Before I even knew it, the race was over...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait... isn't the Oka Sho
going to turn into something incredible!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...! Of course! I was so focused on
Vodka and Scarlet, but
Aston Machan is here too—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I noticed, you know. That everyone was cheating on me.
At the press conference held after the race, those were the very first words spoken.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I know, it's all anyone's talking about.
Even at Chan-chan's race, they were gossiping. Head in the clouds.
Heh, hmm, is that so, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet.
I understand, I totally understand.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Two Umamusume so strong and passionate,
constantly, endlessly aware of each other—
in races, at the academy, and in their room.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely. Isn't it wonderful?
Two forces colliding... it's beautiful.
A fierce rivalry is just so thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't you forget.
Machan is the real star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho isn't just a clash between two rivals; it's a three-way battle. Wouldn't you agree, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Vodka.
Just you wait, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The one taking the Oka Sho...
will be Aston Machan."

"...And so, the challenge she issued
to the two of them became the talk of the town—"
The Oka Sho arrived amidst even greater excitement and fanfare than in typical years.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Wonderful. Social media engagement is excellent as well.
Rumors spread and ignite like wildfire. What a fine era we live in.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We've caught their eyes.
It couldn't have been a more flashy entrance.
Vodka, who showed her prowess in the Hanshin JF and shot to fame overnight, and Daiwa Scarlet, who harbors a fierce rivalry toward her.
Even their relationship at the academy became a hot topic, captivating many people.
The Oka Sho, where everyone's attention was locked on the clash between those two. Breaking into the mix as a forgotten third force—
By pure coincidence, Aston Machan found herself basking in an unprecedented amount of attention.

Only now do I finally understand.
The meaning behind the words she said.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a pillar of fire that Chan couldn't raise alone.
Vivid and dramatic.
Everyone will look up at it in awe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that is when Mar-chan makes her long-awaited entrance.
Truly, the grandest stage in full bloom."
I don't know how she managed it, but it seems that ever since then, she had been plotting to turn the Oka Sho into the most brilliant stage possible.

In the first place, if Aston Machan isn't a strong Umamusume—
butting in on their rivalry would only spoil the mood.
choice_data_list: (So that's why she was so intense about this race...)

text_block_list.text:
"...I can't help but sigh.
This isn't something you can just do through sheer willpower."
What is needed is true ability, and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is going to become
an Ultra Super Mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Without fail. I swear it, without fail.
It's an obsession so intense it stings.

Next is the Oka Sho.
The buds are swelling, and the blossoms are beginning to spill over.
